descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P2 · extra (accessibility, performance, prototype detail) · ours: accessibility (axe, live regions, tap size, phone layout).

Suggestion A2 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was S2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S22 Every empty and failure screen passes axe, is announced, and fits phone widths and WebKit

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Empty patient list: a clear empty state with a way to add patients (scan or "+"). (UAT EFS state 1; TFA-94745 state 1)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane profiles desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit), each with every state on screen: empty lists (both contexts, both Nursing Home views), no-note Post-Round, summary-failure editor, Generate-blocked reason, note-failure message, billing error, Ask AI error, scan error, microphone message, …

When Run axe-core (WCAG 2 A/AA) and the page checks on each state per profile, and screenshot it

Then No axe violations; each failure message sits in a role=alert or role=status region so a screen reader announces it; the add (+), scan and Settings controls on the empty lists have accessible names. On every profile no message is truncated, covered or pushed off screen, there is no sideways scroll, and the add, scan, retry and Dictate controls are at least 2 …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe violations = 0 per screen and the message element's role is alert or status; visual-checks.ts covered / overflow / truncated / tap findings = 0 per screen; vision-review.sh compares the screenshots. On main the Nursing Home '+' and Settings buttons have no title or aria-label, so a button-name violation is expected; findings are evidence for a person. Merges the former S25

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-94745 ready for qa

Screen-reader users are not told about three failures (Hospital pre-round summary failed, Hospital microphone blocked, unreadable scan photo in both modes); the Nursing Home empty list's + and Settings buttons are read only as 'button'; on phones the Nursing Home microphone-blocked toast covers the editor title and Close button, and several buttons are under 44 pt.

Evidence: allure 1dd42d85-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/EFS_S22 (desktop, iPhone 15, Pixel 7): 438 checks pass, 98 fail. Messages lack role=alert/status; NH +/Settings unnamed (expected in the matrix oracle); Pixel 7 unnamed 20×20 px close (X) on the Ask and scan sheets fails WCAG 2.5.8; also contrast failures. Recorded only: with the microphone blocked both editors also show 'Dictation done — review before saving' although nothing was dictated, and sign-in after a session revoke has no 'your session ended' message. The scan-error part repeats in OAT-03/S22. Not in dev report §5 (that lists only the Quick Dictation / Pending Tasks dialog names).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
